checkpoints.change: Exact native Matroska movie interval selection.
Retained Matroska dispatch, native review export and full-width lineage.
Immutable short recorded watch previews, published before final integration.

behavior: AVC/HEVC MKV/WebM originals enter select-movie and export-movie with exact nanoseconds, explicit durations, presentation reordering, clipped intervals, gaps and bounded native decode prerequisites.
The metadata select-matroska API keeps its separate inferred/unknown duration profile. Historical MatroskaSample and import identities remain unchanged; timing uses existing sidecars.
HEVC movie selection retains the preceding IDR through CRA and clears the chain at BLA; the checked-in leading picture requires source samples 0 through 5.
Movie-output v2 lineage encodes all 64 track-id bits. Historical v1 receipts retain their meanings.

Short unapproved entry previews use sealed immutable custody while the writer stays open. Reports are buffered through final source, supporting-capsule, privacy and authority validation under one nonrefilling read allowance.
Approval, retention, dwell and incremental watches retain existing mutation owners. Concurrent head advancement can refuse an immutable preview and requires retry at a stable committed head.
